feature: ADR-0090 independent reload protocol and observed actor generation
abi: No new FFI/unsafe/native ABI/dependency; oracle not rerun.

windows.scope: shared protocol/getters and native config callback/borrow gate need native Windows checks; prior checks pending after automatic approval quota failure

limitations: Independent reload lane must not share progress/Stop streams; no native transport/header-body sender/parser yet.
Protocol validates identity/order/length/generation, not authentication, payload digest or actor commit truth. Trusted caller must finish only after actual activation.
Worker commit may precede ack transport; lost ack must close lane/stop session, not retry or assume rollback.
Active generation getters are metadata, not readiness, actor phase, poll epoch or old held-key release proof.
Native watcher, IPC handles/FDs, cold worker task and user-facing reload command remain unconnected.
No real input/output/capture, new files/subprocesses, OS suspend or driver action in new tests.
Full original cross-platform objective remains incomplete.
